title: OwnLens Robot Policy Schema
description: Owner-defined policy loaded by a robot runtime, governing where/what the robot may do and record. Referenced by spec/RUNTIME.md.

allowed_zones.description: Geofence or room identifiers the robot may operate in.

task_permissions.description: Tasks the robot is permitted to execute, each tied to the manifest-derived episodes it was trained from.

trained_from_episodes.description: Episode IDs (matching manifest.json episode_id values) this task's policy/adapter was trained on, for provenance and revocation.
